issue.title: GMock Linker Error: Build MAVSDK On Windows
issue.body:
I've had trouble building MAVSDK on Windows from source following documentation found [here](https://mavsdk.mavlink.io/develop/en/contributing/build.html). After installing CMake, and Visual Studio 2019 C++ Build Tools, my steps are as follows in Powershell

1. git clone --depth=50 --branch=master https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK.git mavlink/MAVSDK
2. cd .\mavlink\MAVSDK\
3. git checkout master
4. git submodule update --init --recursive

5. cmake -G "Visual Studio 16 2019" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=install -Bbuild/default -S.

This step works fine, and initial output is copied/pasted here.

comments.body: Update: I got it to compile by setting -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF. It seems that setting -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON messes up GTest Linking currently. Some people [here](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/46025439/unresolved-external-symbol-error-with-google-mock-and-vcpkg) have suggested setting a preprocessor definition GTEST_LINKED_AS_SHARED_LIBRARY to the project when doing so... I'm not sure how clean that would be though. Anyways, thanks!
Thanks for reporting! Feel free to open a PR if you later find a way to fix it. In the meantime, I'll close this one :slightly_smiling_face:.
I faced the same issue. @JonasVautherin, won't it be a good idea to change the docs in the meantime?

I am not working on Windows, so all I know is that it works on _my Windows_ (may not be the usual setup since I installed it just for MAVSDK), and it seems like it works [in the CI](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/develop/.github/workflows/main.yml#L477-L510).

Happy to review any PR if you have suggestions to improve the Windows workflow :blush:.
